as_told.title: Grusch's PTSD diagnosis used against him by an agency

plain: A physicist, Eric Davis, says that after David Grusch, a former intelligence officer, filed a whistleblower complaint about secret UFO programs, Grusch and his wife were harassed and intimidated by someone in the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites. The story also holds that his medical file was leaked. A filmmaker, Jeremy Corbell, speaking for Grusch, says the diagnosis in it was post-traumatic stress from combat in Afghanistan in 2013. If true, it would mean officials punished a man for speaking up.
